name: publicWeb_getSong
description: Returns a single song for the public song detail page, scoped to a kennel via HC.KennelSongMap so a caller cannot read another kennel's songs by guessing song ids. Unauthenticated. Missing parameters or an unknown/deleted/removed kennel return the { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } envelope; a song that does not exist, is removed, or is not mapped (non-removed) to the kennel returns an empty rowset.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Public GUID of the kennel — used to scope the song lookup

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: Internal GUID of the song to fetch

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Validation text or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH

rowsets.description: Instead of SongDetail when @publicKennelId or @songId is NULL ('publicKennelId is required.' / 'songId is required.'), when the kennel is not found ('Kennel not found.'), or on any runtime error (CATCH, ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: SongDetail
rowsets.description: Zero or one row. Zero rows = song not found, removed, or not assigned to this kennel.

columns.name: TuneOf
columns.description: Tune this song is sung to

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 75-77 return { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without inserting an HC.ErrorLog row, so a runtime failure is invisible server-side. PublicWebApi does log a Success = 0 envelope as 'HC6 Public Web Error: <action>' with the message, so the failure is not lost, but the row carries no SP name or parameters.
Lines 66-67 read uncommitted data; harmless for lyrics but unnecessary for a single-row lookup.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from the rowset
Never change the zero-row = not found contract — Next.js callers check for empty array
